lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ቤዛ ናይ ይስሓቅ ኣምላከ ኣብርሃም /2/
ንኹሎም ወገኑ ዓደጎም ብደም /2/
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]ብሓሶት ምስክር ከሰሱ ንጐይታ /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ብሞት ንኽቕጻዕ ጨርሑ ብዓውታ /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ጲላጦስ ገረፎ ሰንሰለት ብምእሳር /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ምስ መንግስተ ሮማ ብሓሳብ ብምስማር /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ድንግል ኣይከኣለትን ከተቋርጽ ንብዓት /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]እናረኣየት ወዳ ክሳቐ ስቅያት /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ኣብ ዝፋን ናይ ብርሃን ዝቖማ ኣእጋር /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ከመይ ተዓገሳ ንናይ መስቀል ሽንካር /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ኣኽሊል ናይ ብርሃን ኣብ ሰማይ ዝዕድል /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ደፊኡ ወዓለ ንናይ እሾኽ ኣኽሊል /2/[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Beza nay Yishaq ʾamlake ʾAbriham /2/
Nikhulom wegenu ʿadegom bidem /2/
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]Bihasot miskir kesesu nigoyta /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Bimot nikhqhitsaʿi ch'erhu biʿawta /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]P'ilat'os gerefo senselet bimʾisar /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Mis mengiste roma bihasab bimsimar /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Dingil ʾaykeʾaletn keteqwarts nibʿat /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ʾInareʾayet weda kisaqhe siqyat /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ʾAb zifan nay birhan ziqhoma ʾaʾigar /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Kemey teʿagesa ninay mesqel shinkar /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ʾAkhlil nay birhan ʾab semay ziʿidl /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Defiʾu weʿale ninay ʾishokh ʾakhlil /2/[[/highlight]]
